Build a pipeline for accounts payable: users upload many PDF receipts at once (hundreds). For each receipt extract merchant, date, amount, currency, category, and tax. Every extracted field that comes from the document should be quote-linked back to the source. Output one spreadsheet of all receipt rows. Rename the project to Receipt Spreadsheet.

Fix the receipt spreadsheet so amount and tax are numbers I can sum, not quoted text. Category is a guess (meals, travel) — don't quote it. Currency is often missing, so make it optional plain text. Don't put the original file on each row; that's already the upload. I already uploaded sample_receipt_1.txt and sample_receipt_2.txt — make sure I can actually run with those files.

Keep the existing steps; this is a small fix, not a rebuild.

Build a finance pipeline for our team. We upload many vendor invoices (PDF or photos) each week plus one company travel policy. Extract vendor, invoice date, total, currency, and each line item with quotes back to the invoice text. Flag any line that looks like it violates the travel policy. Output a spreadsheet of all lines with pass/fail plus a short reason. Include a couple of sample invoices and a sample policy so we can try it immediately.
Fixed pipeline: invoice batch → policy → combine → compliance check → output. Added sample invoices and policy for testing.

modules.label: Invoice Uploads
modules.note: Batch upload of vendor invoice files (text stand-ins for PDF/images).
modules.inputDescription: Text files containing vendor invoices (stand-ins for PDF/images)

modules.label: Extract Invoice Fields
modules.inputDescription: List of Document objects - one invoice file each
modules.prompt: Extract vendor, date, total, currency, and line items from this invoice. For each line item: include the description with exact quote, amount as number, and leave policy_violation/violation_reason blank for now.

modules.label: Link Quotes · Extract Invoice Fields
modules.note: Auto · Invoice → Invoice · links LLM quote strings to source spans.

modules.label: Travel Policy
modules.inputDescription: Text file with travel expense rules

modules.label: Merge for Validation
modules.note: Combine extracted invoices with policy text.
modules.inputDescription: Invoice list from extraction plus policy Document

modules.label: Check Policy Compliance
modules.note: Flag violating line items against policy.
modules.inputDescription: AuditInput with invoices and policy text
modules.prompt: For each line item in these invoices, check if it violates the travel policy. Set policy_violation=true and a brief violation_reason if it breaks any rules. Policy: {policy.content}

modules.label: Link Quotes · Check Policy Compliance
modules.note: Auto · Invoice → Invoice · links LLM quote strings to source spans.

modules.label: Flatten Line Items
modules.note: Convert nested invoices to flat line item rows.

# Invoice Compliance Checker

1. Upload multiple invoice text files
2. Upload one travel policy text file
3. Pipeline extracts vendor, date, totals, and line items with source quotes
4. Checks each line against policy rules
5. Outputs flattened spreadsheet with one row per line item and compliance flags
